title: Blog banner (template)
description: The joinmassive.com blog post banner (Sanity's Banner field), 1376×768: a photo with a dark wash from the left, the Massive logo and the headline in red-light. Use Strong wash for a bright photo. The photo recipe is in assets/photo-prompt.txt.

fields.label: Photo
fields.hint: A wide photo; the headline sits over its left side.

fields.label: Headline
fields.default: Seltz: A Web Search API for LLMs
fields.hint: The post's title. Two or three lines; about 60 characters reads best.

fields.label: Wash
fields.hint: Use strong for a bright photo, so the headline stays readable.
